name: Gold vs Commodity Correlations
description: Analyzes rolling correlations between Gold futures (GC) and a broad commodity universe: Crude Oil (CL), Natural Gas (NG), Silver (SI), Copper (HG), Wheat (ZW), Corn (ZC), and Soybeans (ZS). Includes 60-day rolling correlation time series, a full cross-sectional pairwise correlation heatmap, and a summary table of average/min/max correlations to Gold.
source:
# ============================================================================
# Gold vs Commodity Correlations
# Assets: GC, CL, NG, SI, HG, ZW, ZC, ZS
# Outputs:
#   1. Rolling 60-day correlation charts (GC vs each commodity) — dashboard
#   2. Cross-sectional pairwise correlation heatmap (all assets)
#   3. Summary table: mean / min / max rolling correlation to GC
# ============================================================================

# ============================================================================
# DATA LOADING — Continuous futures for all assets
# ============================================================================

src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
cont = futures_continuation(
    timeframe=1D,
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c

# ============================================================================
# DAILY RETURNS — used for correlation calculations
# ============================================================================

ret = returns(period=1)(close)

# ============================================================================
# REFERENCE DATA: Gold (GC) returns via reference_stocks proxy
# We load GC returns as a cross-sectional reference using reference_stocks GLD
# to correlate against each per-asset return series.
# ============================================================================

gc_ref = reference_stocks(ticker='GLD')()
ret_gc = returns(period=1)(gc_ref.c)

# ============================================================================
# ROLLING 60-DAY CORRELATIONS: Each commodity vs Gold
# ============================================================================

corr_60d = rolling_corr(
    window=60,
    window_type=WindowType.rolling,
    method=CorrelationMethod.pearson
)(x=ret_gc, y=ret)

# ============================================================================
# CHART 1: Rolling Correlation to Gold (60-day) — per asset in dashboard
# ============================================================================

idx = index()()

xy_lines(
    title="Rolling 60-Day Correlation to Gold (GC)",
    category="1. Rolling Correlation",
    x_axis_label="Date",
    y_axis_label="Correlation",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="60-Day Corr vs Gold", color=Color.Gold)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="Zero"),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title="+0.5"),
        ReferenceLine(value=-0.5, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title="-0.5")
    ])
)(idx, corr_60d)

# ============================================================================
# CHART 2: Cross-Sectional Pairwise Correlation Heatmap
# Uses daily returns across all 8 futures assets
# ============================================================================

cs_heatmap(
    mode=HeatmapMode.correlation,
    title="Commodity Futures Pairwise Correlation (Daily Returns)",
    category="2. Correlation Heatmap",
    color_axis_min=-1,
    color_axis_max=1,
    show_data_labels=True,
    data_label_format="{point.value:.2f}",
    max_assets=10
)(ret)

# ============================================================================
# CHART 3: Summary Table — Mean / Min / Max rolling correlation to Gold
# ============================================================================

cs_summary_table(
    title="Rolling 60-Day Correlation to Gold — Summary Statistics",
    category="3. Summary Table",
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title="Correlation to Gold (GC) — 60-Day Rolling",
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Mean Corr", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title="Min Corr", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min),
            ColumnSpec(title="Max Corr", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max),
            ColumnSpec(title="Std Dev", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std)
        ]
    )
)(corr_60d, corr_60d, corr_60d, corr_60d)
